scripts.dev:client: node init && npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.railway:build: npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm ci --omit=dev --prefix server
scripts.start: node init && npm run db:init --prefix server && npm start --prefix server
